data.name: Description
data.value: Weighing and Products are open source and need no license. Other modules are opened with a license file; adding a module needs no reinstall.

data.name: NoLicenseText
data.value: No license is loaded. Weighing and Products work without one.

data.name: ClockBehind
data.value: This computer's clock is behind a time Vyxum has already seen. The license term is counted from the latest time seen, so setting the clock back does not extend it.

data.name: ReadFailed
data.value: The file could not be read.

data.name: RemoveConfirm
data.value: Remove the license? Paid modules are locked again; your records are kept.

data.name: Error.invalid_format
data.value: This is not a Vyxum license file.

data.name: Error.unsupported_format
data.value: This license file was made for a newer version of Vyxum. Update Vyxum or ask for a file in the current format.

data.name: Error.unknown_key
data.value: The file was signed with a key this version of Vyxum does not know.

data.name: Error.invalid_signature
data.value: The signature does not match: the file was changed or damaged. Ask for a new file.

data.name: Error.invalid_payload
data.value: The contents of the license file are incomplete or unreadable.

data.name: Error.too_large
data.value: The file is too large to be a license file.

data.name: Error.unknown_device
data.value: One of the chosen devices no longer exists. Reload the page and choose again.

data.name: Error.station_limit_exceeded
data.value: The license allows fewer stations than chosen. Clear a device and save again.

data.name: Error.stations_too_long
data.value: Too many devices are chosen to be stored.

data.name: Error.unknown
data.value: The request could not be completed.

data.name: ReplaceConfirm
data.value: A license that works is loaded now. The new file replaces it; if the file has ended or has not started yet, paid modules become read-only or locked. Continue?

data.name: UploadedReadOnly
data.value: The file was loaded, but the license has ended and its grace period is over: paid modules are read-only. Load a current license file.

data.name: UploadedNotYetValid
data.value: The file was loaded, but the license starts on {0}: paid modules stay locked until then.

data.name: UploadedGrace
data.value: The file was loaded, but the license has ended: {0} days of grace are left, then paid modules become read-only. Load a current license file.

data.name: Error.license_required
data.value: This action needs a valid license. The license state was refreshed.

data.name: Error.license_read_only
data.value: The license has ended, so the module is read-only and cannot change records. The license state was refreshed.

data.name: StationsHint
data.value: Each licensed station is one device (scale). Choose the devices that may use the paid modules; weighing itself is never limited.

data.name: StationsNoDevices
data.value: No device has been added yet. Add one under Devices.

data.name: BannerGrace
data.value: License expired; paid modules keep working for {0} more days.

data.name: BannerReadOnly
data.value: License term ended; paid modules are read-only.

data.name: StepHeading
data.value: Do you have a license file?

data.name: StepDescription
data.value: Weighing and Products are free. A license file opens the paid modules; you can also load it later under Settings.

data.name: OptionFreeHint
data.value: Weighing, Products and Records work without a license.

data.name: OptionFileHint
data.value: A file with the extension .vxlic that you received from us.
